title: AI assistants for software developers
why: AI pair-programming speeds up boilerplate, debugging and learning new libraries.
what_is_different: Developers must keep understanding the code, protect secrets and proprietary code, write tests, and review AI output like a colleague's pull request.

extra_modules.title: Test-first with AI
extra_modules.outcome: You can: make AI generate code that is proven by tests
extra_modules.practice: Implement a function test-first with AI help

starter_project: Ship a small feature with AI assistance: tests first, AI-assisted implementation, code review checklist and a security check for secrets.
pitfalls: Leaking API keys or proprietary code

expert_validation.note: AI-drafted outline; to be validated by a practitioner and an educator in this field.
